sacred-patterns, then an index of 3d-models' decisions. Grouped by
problem-tag (shared vocabulary in each repo's `docs/decisions/tags.yaml`).

`docs/decision-schema.md`.

Sibling repos are read at the remote-tracking ref named in the comment
above, not from their working trees, so no row here can move because
somebody else switched a branch. sacred-patterns is read from the
working tree because it is the repo being edited.
